messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty alert fired: external-lb-health (eu-west-1) — high TLS handshake error rate + ALB target unhealthy count spike. Auto-page to oncall-sre.

pagerduty: Incident created and auto-escalated to schedule 'sre-oncall'. URL: https://pd.example/incidents/INC123456

oncall-sre: acked. I'm on it. Starting triage — checking ALB target groups and TLS metrics.

oncall-sre: quick check: `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:... | jq '.TargetHealthDescriptions[] | {Id: .Target.Id, State: .TargetHealth.State}'` — several targets in tg-eu-1 show Unhealthy.

oncall-sre: curl to edge endpoint from my laptop: `curl -v https://api.eu.redwood.example/health` -> TLS handshake fails at `SSL routines:tls_process_server_certificate:certificate verify failed` for some connections, others succeed. Intermittent.

oncall-sre: running `openssl s_client -connect api.eu.redwood.example:443 -servername api.eu.redwood.example` -> handshake times out intermittently, `write:errno=104`.

ashley: seeing similar from Europe monitoring: 5xx from edge LB -> backend timeout / TLS handshake errors spike at 12:04 UTC. Dashboard: 12:03–12:08 spike to 18% handshake error rate.

oncall-sre: digging into recent deploys — last cert rotation for edge proxies rolled 11:58 UTC. Can someone check cert rotation job? @kevin

kevin: I rolled the certs earlier in eu-west-1 as planned. Logs show certs uploaded to SSM and distributed to proxy fleet via rollout job. No obvious failures in rollout job logs. However I see ~120 failed restarts on proxy instances during rollout window. Investigating.

oncall-sre: ok — two likely vectors: 1) certs + proxy restarts causing partial TLS issues; 2) ALB targets flapping/unhealthy. Workstream: (A) confirm proxy certs and health, (B) shift traffic away from eu-west-1 to eu-central-1 as temporary mitigation, (C) reduce DNS TTL / trigger weighted failover.

maria: on (A). Querying proxy instances: `kubectl get pods -n edge -l region=eu-west-1 -o wide` shows many pods in CrashLoopBackOff during 11:58–12:06. Pod logs show `error reading cert chain: file not found` for a subset. Looks like rollout job missed a path on ~10% of pods.

oncall-sre: that matches. If proxies lost certs they might present bad chains -> TLS handshake anomalies. We need to fix certs on those pods. Maria, can you roll a targeted job to re-mount certs on failed pods? Use `edge-cert-reconcile --region eu-west-1 --instance-filter crash-loop`

maria: starting targeted reconcile now. Will update once done.

support-bot: customer-impact ticker opened: Impacted customers in eu-west-1 experiencing 5xx and partial request failures for inference and chat. Estimated affected sessions: ~2.1k active in window.

oncall-sre: (B) traffic shift — I'll initiate a temporary weight shift in global LB: set eu-west=10%, eu-central=90% to drain. Doing weighted update now.

oncall-sre: `aws route53 change-weighted-record-set --hosted-zone-id ZZZ --change-batch file://weights.json` -> submitted change id CHANGE-12345. Note: TTLs are 60s.

oncall-sre: monitoring — backend error rate in eu-west trending down as traffic shifts. Connecting to ALB, target health shows Unhealthy count decreasing after drain.

kevin: also found that one proxy rollout task failed due to a race on S3 object version — fixed in rollout script. Pushing small fix and re-running reconcile.

maria: reconcile done. Verified pods now serving with correct certs. `kubectl logs` shows successful key load. TLS handshake success rate on probes improved to >98% after reconcile.

oncall-sre: good. Switching to recovery plan: keep eu-central weight at 80% for next 10m, then gradually restore eu-west as we confirm stability.

ashley: customer comms draft in #support: "We're investigating intermittent TLS failures in eu-west-1 that impacted API traffic. We've shifted traffic and applied a fix; we're monitoring. Will follow up with root cause." Ready to send once we confirm 10m stable.

oncall-sre: will wait 10 more minutes. If stable, I'll remove page and mark incident as mitigated. @pagerduty please hold escalation.

pagerduty: Manual ack recorded by oncall-sre. Escalation paused.

oncall-sre: followup checks: `dig +short api.eu.redwood.example @8.8.8.8` -> multiple A records, TTL 60. Route53 weight change propagated. ALB healthy hosts count steady.

oncall-sre: final: metrics stable for 12m, TLS handshake error back to baseline, ALB TargetHealthyCount normal. Closing pager in 5m if no regressions.

kevin: root cause notes for postmortem: cert rollout job had a race condition with S3 object versioning causing missing cert mounts on ~10% of proxies -> crash loops -> TLS handshake failures observed at edge + ALB unhealthy targets -> triggered PD. Fix: add stronger retry and version pin in rollout script.

oncall-sre: thanks — will start incident writeup and link logs/CHANGE-12345. Marking as mitigated and start RCA.

support-bot: Incident mitigated status: partial outage resolved. Customers impacted: EU region; estimated affected sessions 2.1k; mitigation: cert reconcile and traffic weight shift. Postmortem owner: kevin.

oncall-sre: closing thread. :white_check_mark:
